comment: C ref: cmd.c rhack() (3731-3735, 3748-3760, 3803-3825), parse() (5126-5140) and do_repeat() (1637-1660). A count and an 'm' prefix before a window command: a counted discoveries command keeps dodiscovered in CQ_REPEAT and parse() reuses gl.last_command_count for ^A; with the 'm' prefix both do_reqmenu and dodiscovered are queued (3731-3735 skips the clear once a prefix was seen), so ^A asks for the ordering again. A named command: doextcmd() reports its row through ge.ext_tlist and rhack() adds it to CQ_REPEAT after it runs and shifts it in front of the answers the handler read, so ^A after #close and a direction closes in the same direction without asking, and ^A after #known opens the discoveries again. A Wizard, who has spells and discoveries from the start, on the default legacy and tutorial prompts; seed, clock and keys chosen independently.
